Announcements

Nov 24
Executive Order (EO) 13658
Executive Order (EO) 13658 generally applies to contracts subject to the Service Contract Act or the Davis-Bacon Act awarded between January 1, 2015, and January 29, 2022, and not renewed or extended on or after January 30, 2022. EO 13658 sets a minimum wage of $14.05 per hour for workers performing on o...
Nov 18
Integrity Records Now on SAM.gov
Integrity Records are now managed, created, and reviewed on SAM.gov. These functionalities are no longer available on CPARS.gov. To learn more about data entry and accessing these records on SAM.gov, please go to sam.gov/cpars.
Oct 28
New Certification for Higher Education Institutions Now Available
Starting October 28, 2026 higher education institutions might have to certify their intercollegiate athletics revenue per EO 14400: Urgent National Action to Save College Sports. Refer to this knowledge article for more information.
Oct 19
SAM Site Certificates Validity and Renewal Updates
In accordance with new industry standards, website certificates will expire after 100 days starting March 15, 2027, and certificate providers will stop offering longer validity periods. To adapt to this change, all new SAM certificates will renew automatically, as manual renewals are no longer susta...
Jun 26
ISR Workspace: Increased Contract Volume
Following the implementation of revisions to the ISR eligibility logic within the Subcontracting Plan Reporting system on June 9, 2026, contractors might observe an increased volume of contracts and subcontracts in their Eligible Workspace.
